Definition: stink-weed or any other noxious or useless plant
BiblicalUsage: Stinkweed is the word for a noxious, useless plant, and it appears once, in Job's oath. In Job 31:40 Job says, let thistles grow instead of wheat, and cockle instead of barley — and the words of Job are ended. A curse on his own fields, if he has done what he is accused of.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Job's stinkweed is the mark of a clear conscience: he is willing to let his fields grow weeds if he has lied.
